name: Vegetable Area Expansion
benefit:
- To promote vegetable production, seasonal vegetable seeds are provided to farmers at a 50% subsidy. Farmers are required to apply approximately two months before planting seasonal vegetables.
  - For example, if a packet of bottle gourd seeds costs ₹200/-, the farmer pays ₹100/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre, while the government bears the remaining ₹100/- as a subsidy, allowi
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 2 hectares.
